0022600042.text: The Oklahoma City Thunder (8-4, 6-4 in their last ten) visit the 2-8 LA Clippers as they try to snap a two-game losing streak, sitting 3rd in the Northwest and 7th in the West while going 3-4 on the road. The Clippers, 13th in the West, have lost their last eight and are 0-5 at home, while the Thunder lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 108-101 win in Oklahoma City on October 25, and they also won all three meetings in 2025-26. For the Thunder, Cason Wallace, Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Jaylin Williams and Thomas Sorber are out, and Ajay Mitchell is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision. For the Clippers, Bradley Beal, Brandon Ingram, Jordan Miller and Yanic Konan Niederhauser are out, and Cam Christie is day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision.
